questions.question:
Given below are two sets of numbers. In each set of numbers, a certain mathematical operation on the first number results in the second number. Which of the options follows the same operation as given in the question?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole number, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(21, 10)

(87, 43)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **2nd number × 2 + 1 = 1st number.**

**For, **(21, 10)

⇒ 10 × 2 + 1 = 21

⇒ 20 + 1 = 21.

**For, **(87, 43)

⇒ 43 × 2 + 1 = 87

⇒ 86 + 1 = 87.

Similarly,

(27, 13)

⇒ 13 × 2 + 1 = ?

⇒ 26 + 1 = 27.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

No crow is a parrot.

No parrot is a sparrow.

No crow is a sparrow.

Conclusions:

(I) No sparrow is a crow.

(II) No parrot is a crow.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Statements:

No crow is a parrot.

No parrot is a sparrow.

No crow is a sparrow.

The least possible Venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5857b1f34f7d12a95d41d939b6dd7eea2da207725b615a01c26da47b06ccfc3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ef5e7e8ac4758bb565d72ffd2aeb9a6819b1bf67e4d099605b7c639237371ba.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No sparrow is a crow - **True**(Because, no crow is sparrow is given which implies that no sparrow is crow).

(II) No parrot is a crow - **True**(Because, no crow is parrot is given which implies that no parrot is crow).

Thus, Both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if ‘−’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged and ‘+’ and ‘×’ are interchanged?

7 + 5 ÷ 4 + 5 ÷ 36 − 4 × 7 = ?
questions.solution:
```html

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 7 + 5 ÷ 4 + 5 ÷ 36 − 4 × 7 = ?

Now, if ‘−’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged and ‘+’ and ‘×’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 7 × 5 − 4 × 5 − 36 ÷ 4 + 7

Step 1: Solve the ‘×’ and ‘÷’ operations first:

⇒ 35 − 20 − 9 + 7

Step 2: Perform addition and subtraction from left to right:

⇒ 35 − 20 = 15

⇒ 15 − 9 = 6

⇒ 6 + 7 = 13

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

``

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All lakes are rivers.

All rivers are dams.

Conclusions:

(I) At least some dams are lakes.

(II) All rivers are lakes.
questions.solution:
Statements:

All lakes are rivers.

All rivers are dams.

The least possible Venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee80b53dd2525dfbaf828e1cfc621a0832ad7a3b992cf7ca2d8704955d91e069.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fc20c29398270f1ce223802b70e5e0226ae2050aaf88629c94773e5ba568b21.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) At least some dams are lakes - **True**(Because, All lakes are rivers and All rivers are dams it implies that some dams are lake as well).

(II) All rivers are lakes - **False**(Because, All lakes are rivers it implies that some lakes are rivers, so it can be possible only).

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
